behavior_before: A bounded scan requested for one asset could mark unrelated indexed assets missing, and repeated provider placeholder result IDs could turn valid independent batches into conflicts.
behavior_after: Requested scans limit missing-state reconciliation to the requested subtree, and Estate-owned result identity prevents provider placeholder collisions while preserving conflict handling.
new_failure_modes: provider placeholder identity collision detected and preserved
changed_failure_modes: bounded scans no longer mark assets outside the requested scope missing
validation_evidence: 3 accepted Level 1 backlog candidates after Estate-owned result-ID repair
full governed scan restored 5,832 admitted assets with zero missing/failed
preliminary_troubleshooting_notes: Stale packets must be rejected and followed by a narrow deterministic rescan; provider conflicts and timeouts remain review/retry evidence and must not be overwritten.
prohibited_recovery_actions: Do not promote candidates, expand scope, browse outside packets, mutate files, schedule unattended inference, or perform GPU stress/reset operations.
activation_restart_impact: No daemon or scheduler restart; worker remains operator-invoked and SQLite remains a rebuildable runtime projection.
